indication_area: Drug-resistant Gram-negative bacterial infections (complicated urinary tract infections; hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated bacterial pneumonia)
annual_basis: Shionogi's fiscal years 2019-2025 (April-March), read from each fiscal year's own results presentation 'Revenue by Segment' table, where Fetroja is itemised under Shionogi Inc. (U.S.); FY2019 is the prior-year column of the FY2020 presentation. Each period is relabelled as the year in which the April-March fiscal year ends (FY2016 = April 2016-March 2017 is period 2017).

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 209445 NDA APPROVAL ... FETROJA (cefiderocol) for injection ... This new drug application provides for the use of FETROJA (cefiderocol) for injection

series_start_reason: FY2019 (April 2019-March 2020) is the year containing the February 2020 U.S. launch; Shionogi prints 0.0 B yen for it.
notes: The line is the Fetroja row under 'Shionogi Inc.' in 'Overseas subsidiaries/export'; European sales are a separate line under the brand name Fetcroja (Shionogi B.V.) and are not included. Figures are billions of yen to one decimal place, so each year carries up to +/-50 million yen of rounding. Shionogi prints cumulative year-to-date figures only (see no_quarterly_series), so this is an annual series; quarterly values could be derived by differencing year-to-date figures from separate presentations but were not, because no single document prints both inputs. Shionogi Inc. is a subsidiary reporting inside Shionogi & Co.; Fetroja is also sold in Japan by Shionogi (approved there later), which this line does not include.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: Shionogi 2Q FY2022 presentation, Revenue by Segment (April-September cumulative) | Fetroja ® - - 4.7 - 2.9 65.0 1.9
no_quarterly_series.details: Each Shionogi quarterly presentation prints the Fetroja line for the cumulative fiscal year to date (three, six, nine or twelve months), never for the single quarter; the supplements' quarterly-trend tables list Shionogi Inc. in total but not Fetroja. Quarters are not interpolated per contract.

search_log: Scanned the English quarterly financial-results presentations, supplements, transcripts and press-conference decks linked from shionogi.com/global/en/investors/ir-library/presentation-materials.html and financial-results-supplement.html (first ~130 documents, in alphabetical-path order, with pdfplumber) for Fetroja/Fetcroja/Mulpleta lines; not all 359 linked documents were scanned.
Fetroja appears as a separate line under Shionogi Inc. in the Revenue by Segment tables from the FY2020 results (May 2021) onward; FY2020 presentation footnote: 'Launched in Feb. 2020'.
FY2019 results presentation (e_p200511.pdf) was searched and prints no Fetroja figure; FY2019 comes from the FY2020 presentation's prior-year column (0.0).

Looked for a quarterly Fetroja figure: the 4. Quarterly trend (Revenue by segment) tables of FY2022-FY2025 supplements carry Shionogi Inc. in total, not Fetroja; the quarterly presentations carry cumulative figures only.
No other issuer was searched for Fetroja U.S. net sales (Zai Lab, the Greater China licensee, was not checked).
